cases.prompt: Find the opening shot in the supplied timeline and check its selected image and voice.
cases.operational_addendum: Open the current composition, expand the opening shot, and tell me which image and voice belong to it and where I would make a change.

cases.prompt: Before editing one occurrence, identify its timeline placement, shot, and selected media.
cases.operational_addendum: Open the named occurrence and tell me which shot and media it currently uses. Point out the IDs that distinguish the occurrence, shot revision, and media so I can make a scoped edit.

cases.prompt: Review the supplied images and cue times before arranging a short montage.
cases.operational_addendum: Open the supplied montage images and the timeline around their cue points. Tell me which images and cue times are available so I can plan the edit.

materials: a prepared starting render for the same revision
cases.prompt: Check whether the opening shot shown in the saved timeline agrees with its prepared starting preview.
cases.operational_addendum: Open the supplied timeline and its prepared starting preview for the same shot. Tell me whether the selected image and shot placement agree, and which saved revision the preview represents.

materials: a retained historical alternative for the target shot
cases.prompt: Check whether an older source is still used after the shot's picture changed.
cases.operational_addendum: Inspect the selected picture and any supplied retained alternatives for the named shot. Tell me what is active now and what is only history before I replace anything. If the retained alternative is absent, report that setup input as missing.

materials: the supplied detached draft and its validator diagnostic
cases.prompt: A saved timeline changed after this draft was opened; check whether the draft can still be applied.
cases.operational_addendum: Inspect the supplied detached draft and its validator diagnostic. Tell me which revision it was based on and what safe next step the diagnostic supports. Do not apply the stale draft.

materials: the labelled legacy shot example and its canonical comparison
cases.prompt: Review the supplied older shot record alongside its canonical timeline entry before migrating it.
cases.operational_addendum: Compare the labelled legacy example with the canonical records supplied for the same material. Tell me which timing and media information can be carried forward and what is absent.

materials: separately role-labelled title, script, transcript, and prompt text
cases.prompt: Before changing a title, distinguish the visible wording from any supplied script, transcript, and prompt.
cases.operational_addendum: Inspect the text roles supplied for the named shot. Tell me the exact text available in each role and which requested material is missing. If separate role-labelled text is not supplied, report that setup input as missing.

cases.prompt: Before sharing this edit, compare the starting render, an older export, and the prepared candidate preview.
cases.operational_addendum: Use the supplied output records to tell me which preview matches the saved timeline and which are historical or candidate-only. If a required output record is missing, report that setup input instead of guessing.

materials: a named shot with its selected voice clip
cases.prompt: Find the named shot, listen to its supplied voice clip, and return to the parent composition.
cases.operational_addendum: Use the project entry point to locate the named shot and play its voice. Tell me when you are back at the parent and where the shot sits in the timeline. If playback support is unavailable, report the missing setup capability.

cases.prompt: In {opening shot}, replace the old mink video with the charcoal pixel-mink image. Keep its timing, voiceover, and frame overlay. Show me the preview, then save it to this test timeline.
Remove {redundant shot}, including its own voiceover, and close the space it leaves. Keep the other shots intact and keep the continuous music bed at its original source position.
Move {closing shot} to immediately before {middle shot}. Move its image, voiceover, and caption together. Keep all shot lengths and the total running time the same.
Make a second version of {feature shot} right after it, change the copy to {alternate image}, and name it ‘Feature alternate’. Keep the original untouched, including its voiceover and title.

Tighten the intro by ending each spoken shot six frames after its last voice clip ends, then bring the next shot up. Don't cut any voice audio or change words, playback speed, or the order. Leave shots with no voice alone; keep the music continuous from its original start.
Change the on-screen title in {title shot} to ‘A more curious internet’. Keep the voiceover script and spoken audio exactly as they are, and keep the title's style and screen time.
Make the background music six decibels quieter throughout this excerpt. Leave the voiceover at the same level and keep everything in sync.
In {demonstration shot}, use source seconds 2 through 4 of the terminal video and start it on the supplied cue at {cue time}. Keep the voiceover fixed and fill the rest with the existing still image.

Make a four-quadrant montage from these four supplied images in {montage shot}. Start with one in each quadrant, then rotate them clockwise at each supplied music cue. Keep the music and voice untouched.

Add a new 20-second montage after {last shot}: use the 200 images in this supplied collection from darkest to brightest, each for 0.1 seconds. Use every image exactly once, break brightness ties by media ID, and leave the existing intro unchanged.
